description: This file contains code for generating a course-wise assessment report in an educational ERP system, including data processing, formatting, and chart data generation.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate the course-wise assessment report, returning columns, data, and chart info.

methods.name: get_formatted_result
methods.description: Fetches and formats assessment results from the database into a nested dictionary structure.

methods.name: get_column
methods.description: Generates column definitions for the report based on assessment criteria.

methods.name: get_chart_data
methods.description: Prepares data for rendering a bar chart of grades distribution across assessment criteria.

methods.name: get_child_assessment_groups
methods.description: Retrieves child assessment groups if the given group is a parent group.
